laboratorio.title: AI Lab — NX-Studio
laboratorio.description: Applied AI experiments: agents, RAG and automation proven in real production.
laboratorio.heading: Describe your idea → get a visual mockup
laboratorio.sub: We chat about what you want to build, I ask you refinement questions and we generate a concept image of your product in seconds. No sign-up, no backend, everything in your browser.

chat.title: ◈ Ideation chat
chat.sub: We refine your idea in 3–5 messages
chat.greeting: Hi! I'm the NX-Studio assistant. Tell me: what product or system do you want to build?
chat.greetingAgain: Hi again! I'm the NX-Studio assistant. Tell me: what product or system do you want to build?

questions.0: Interesting. Who is the main user and what concrete problem does it solve for them?
questions.1: Perfect. On which platform do you picture it: web app, mobile, desktop, or a combined physical/digital thing?
questions.2: Great. What feeling do you want to convey when they use it: professional and minimalist, colorful and fun, futuristic, or something warmer/organic?
questions.3: Almost there. Do you have any visual reference you like? If not, give me 2-3 style keywords (e.g. "Apple style, neutral colors, lots of space").
questions.4: I've got everything! Give me a second to generate your mockup...

mockup.title: ◎ Brutalist mockup
mockup.sub: Deterministic wireframe, generated in your browser

laboratorio.disclaimer: ◇ The lab uses no backend or external services: mockups are generated in your browser with the brutalist system. Your conversation is not stored on any server.

cta.title: Like what you see in the mockup?
cta.desc: We set aside 30 free minutes. You describe it to me in person, I refine it with you and deliver a working prototype within 72 hours.

brand.title: Brand — NX-Studio
brand.description: NX-Studio brand identity: logotypes, usage and guidelines.
brand.heading: Visual identity
brand.sub: Logo system as an Astro component (vector HTML+CSS+SVG). Retina-ready, animatable, zero-runtime. Three variants available.

v1.note: Default. Hexagonal glyph + "NX-Studio" text in one line. Scales to 4 sizes.

v2.note: Glyph + text + "SOFTWARE STUDIO · LATAM" tagline. For large pieces.

v3.note: Hexagonal glyph only. For favicon, product badges, watermark.

specs.title: Technical specs
specs.render: Render: inline SVG + CSS gradients (no external images)
specs.js: Bundled JS: 0 bytes (all CSS + inline SVG)

logos.title: Logos — NX-Studio
logos.description: NX-Studio logotype variants and high-resolution downloads.
logos.sub: Vector SVG editable in code. The one you approve gets integrated as a `colorway` prop in `Brand.astro`. Each is single-source (vector SVG path, scalable to any size).

testNav.title: Test in Nav (live)
testNav.desc: Pick a logo and see how it behaves in the compact top bar:

logos.footerNoteA: Once you approve one, I'll integrate it into
logos.footerNoteB: as a variant and commit it.

hexagon.desc: Hexagon with fused N and X inside. Hard-edge chamfer. Currently applied. Steel-indigo palette.
hexagon.feel: Industrial, stable, pure tech. Vibe Linear / Prisma.

chevron.desc: Two interlaced chevrons forming N+X. Suggests forward, progress, deployment.
chevron.feel: Modern, webdev, devops. Vibe Vercel / Railway / Turso.

negative.desc: N and X form the negative space between two angular blocks. Only the glyph silhouette.
negative.feel: Editorial, designer, premium. Vibe Anthropic / OpenAI.

crosshair.desc: Crosshair cursor with integrated N and X. For developer tools, technical agencies, infra.
crosshair.feel: CLI, sysadmin, infra as code. Vibe Terraform / HashiCorp.

prism.desc: Triangle forming an X with faces in lava + indigo + gold. Fractal, light-bending.
prism.feel: Creative, AI-first, visual. Vibe Suno / Udio / ideograms.

wave.desc: Audio wave forming N+X between peaks. Ties into your DJ/producer profile in Neiva.
wave.feel: Warm, personal, with soul. Vibe Monolith / Framer / Loop.

circuit.desc: Square pads with a circuit trace drawing NX. Feels semiconductor, controller.
circuit.feel: Hardware, firmware, edge computing. Vibe Arduino / Raspberry.

monogram.desc: N and X carved in a gradient circle. No forced geometry. Just typography.
monogram.feel: Massimo Vignelli, editorial, timeless. Vibe BMW / Audi / Porsche.

chatbot.title: SophIA
chatbot.subtitle: NX-Studio virtual assistant
chatbot.help_text:
Available commands:
• /help — show this help
• /reset — clear the conversation
• /portalsignup — go to the client portal

You can also ask me in Spanish, English or Portuguese about pricing, services, templates, the lab or contact info.
chatbot.reset_done: Conversation reset. How can I help?
chatbot.portalsignup: Taking you to the client portal in a new tab. If you don't have an account yet, you can create one when you arrive.
chatbot.mock_greeting: Hi! I'm SophIA, NX-Studio's virtual assistant. What can I help you with today? Ask me about pricing, services, templates or type /help to see every command.
chatbot.mock_pricing: Pricing depends on scope. Every project starts with a free discovery call; afterwards we send a proposal with an indicative range and suggested band. For an immediate estimate, open the quote builder (/cotizador) or tell me what you need and I'll loop in the team.
chatbot.mock_handoff: I'll connect you with the human team. Meanwhile, tell me about your project in 2-3 lines and we'll speed up the first contact. Typical response in under 24 business hours.
chatbot.mock_unknown: I'm not sure I understood. I can help with pricing, services, templates, the lab or handing you off to a human. Try /help for commands.
chatbot.mock_services: We have three lines: custom applications, embedded QA & testing, and applied AI (chatbots, agents, RAG). Each one has a concrete deliverable. Which one would you like to explore?
chatbot.mock_templates: We have production-ready templates (landing, dashboard, e-commerce) ready to buy and deploy. MIT-licensed, no royalties, support during the first sprint. Head over to /templates to see the catalog.
chatbot.mock_labs: The AI lab is where we experiment with mockup generation, agents and prototypes. No backend, all in your browser. If you want to see one live, /laboratorio.
chatbot.mock_contact: For direct contact: form at /contacto (saves to backend and notifies the team), or /cotizador for an immediate estimate. Also /portalsignup if you prefer to create an account on the portal.
chatbot.mock_thanks: You're welcome! If you need anything else, I'm right here.
chatbot.empty_state: Start the conversation with a greeting or /help to see commands.
chatbot.footer_disclaimer: SophIA is an automated assistant. Responses are indicative; the team confirms any formal proposal.
